statement_en: Let $E_1,\cdots,E_n,\cdots \in \mathcal{F}$ be an increasing sequence of sets, that is, $E_1\subseteq E_2 \subseteq \cdots \subseteq E_n \cdots$. Then the union is measurable and its measure satisfies $$\mu\left(\bigcup_{n\geq 1}E_n\right)=\lim_{n\to \infty}\mu(E_n)=\sup_{n\geq 1}\mu(E_n).$$
